verses.translation: Then I looked, and, behold, over the firmament that was above the head of the cherubs there was a likeness of a throne over them, as a sapphire stone.

translations.ron: Privind eu atunci, am văzut pe bolta, care era deasupra capetelor heruvimilor, ceva asemănător la înfăţişare cu un tron de rege, ca piatra de safir.

verses.translation: And he said to the man clothed with the long robe, Go in between the wheels that are under the cherubs, and fill thine hands with coals of fire from between the cherubs, and scatter them over the city. And he went in in my sight.

translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul către omul cel îmbrăcat în haina de in: "Intră între roţile cele de sub heruvimi şi umple-ţi pumnii de cărbuni aprinşi, pe care-I vei lua dintre heruvimi, şi-i aruncă asupra cetăţii!" Şi el a intrat acolo înaintea ochilor mei;

verses.translation: And the cherubs stood on the right hand of the house, as the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

translations.ron: Şi când a intrat omul acela, heruvimii stăteau în partea dreaptă a casei şi un nor umplea curtea cea dinăuntru.

verses.translation: Then the glory of the Lord departed from the cherubs to the porch of the house; and the cloud filled the house, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord.

translations.ron: Atunci s-a ridicat slava Domnului de pe heruvimi spre pragul templului şi templul s-a umplut de nori, iar curtea s-a umplut de strălucirea slavei Domnului.

verses.translation: And the sound of the cherubs' wings was heard as far as the outer court, as the voice of the Almighty God speaking.

translations.ron: Freamătul aripilor heruvimilor se auzea până şi în curtea de afară, ca glasul când vorbeşte Dumnezeu Atotputernicul.

verses.translation: And it came to pass, when he gave a charge to the man clothed with the sacred robe, saying, Take fire from between the wheels from between the cherubs, that he went in, and stood near the wheels.

translations.ron: Când a dat Domnul poruncă omului celui îmbrăcat cu haină de in şi i-a zis: "Ia foc dintre roţile cele dintre heruvimi", şi când a intrat el şi a stat lângă roţi,

verses.translation: And he stretched forth his hand into the midst of the fire that was between the cherubs, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of the man clothed with the sacred robe: and he took it, and went out.

translations.ron: Atunci unul din heruvimi şi-a întins mâna în focul cel dintre heruvimi, a luat şi a dat în pumni celui îmbrăcat în haină de in, iar el, luându-l, a ieşit.

verses.translation: And I saw the cherubs having the likeness of men's hands under their wings.

translations.ron: Şi la heruvimi sub aripi se vedeau un fel de mâini omeneşti.

verses.translation: And I saw, and behold, four wheels stood by the cherubs, one wheel by each cherub: and the appearance of the wheels was as the appearance of a carbuncle stone.

translations.ron: Căutând eu atunci, am văzut lângă heruvimi patru roţi, câte o roată lângă fiecare heruvim; roţile acestea erau la vedere ca şi crisolitul.

verses.translation: And as for their appearance, there was one likeness to the four, as if there should be a wheel in the midst of a wheel.

translations.ron: După făptură erau toate la fel şi parcă erau vârâte una în alta.

verses.translation: When they went, they went on their four sides; they turned not when they went, for whichever way the first head looked, they went; and they turned not as they went.

translations.ron: Când ele mergeau, mergeau în toate patru părţile, şi în vremea mersului nu se întorceau, ci încotro era îndreptat capul heruvimului, într-acolo mergeau, şi în vremea mersului nu se întorceau.

verses.translation: And their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes round about the four wheels.

translations.ron: Tot trupul heruvimilor, spatele lor, mâinile lor şi aripile lor erau pline de ochi; asemenea şi roţile, toate cele patru roţi de jur împrejur...

verses.translation: And these wheels were called Gelgel in my hearing.

translations.ron: Roţilor acestora, după cum am auzit eu, li s-a zis: "Galgal" (Vijelie).

verses.translation: And the cherubs were the same living creature which I saw by the river of Chobar.

translations.ron: Atunci heruvimii s-au ridicat; ei erau aceleaşi fiare pe care le văzusem la râul Chebar.

verses.translation: And when the cherubs went, the wheels went, and they were close to them: and when the cherubs lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, their wheels turned not.

translations.ron: Când mergeau heruvimii, mergeau şi roţile pe lângă ei, iar când heruvimii îşi ridicau aripile ca să se ridice de la pământ, nici roţile nu se despărţeau, ci erau împreună cu ei.

verses.translation: When they stood, the wheels stood; and when they mounted up, the wheels mounted up with them: because the spirit of life was in them.

translations.ron: Când aceia stăteau, stăteau şi acestea; iar când se ridicau aceia, şi acestea se ridicau, pentru că duhul fiarelor era şi în ele.

verses.translation: Then the glory of the Lord departed from the house, and went up on the cherubs.

translations.ron: Atunci slava Domnului s-a dus de la prag şi s-a aşezat pe heruvimi.

verses.translation: And the cherubs lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight: when they went forth, the wheels were also beside them, and they stood at the entrance of the front gate of the house of the Lord; and the glory of the God of Israel was upon them above.

translations.ron: Iar heruvimii, întinzând aripile, s-au ridicat de la pământ înaintea ochilor mei şi s-au dus însoţiţi de roţi şi s-au oprit la poarta cea dinspre răsărit a templului Domnului, şi slava Dumnezeului lui Israel era deasupra lor.

verses.translation: This is the living creature which I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chobar; and I knew that they were cherubs.

translations.ron: Aceştia erau aceleaşi fiare, pe care le văzusem eu la picioarele Dumnezeului lui Israel, la râul Chebar.

verses.translation: Each one had four faces, and each one had eight wings; and under their wings was the likeness of men's hands.

translations.ron: Fiecare avea câte patru feţe şi fiecare avea câte patru aripi, iar sub aripi aveau un fel de mâini omeneşti.

verses.translation: And as for the likeness of their faces, these are the same faces which I saw under the glory of the God of Israel by the river of Chobar: and they went each straight forward.

translations.ron: Chipul feţelor şi înfăţişarea lor era ca acelea pe care le văzusem la râul Chebar, ba şi ei înşişi erau aceiaşi. Fiecare mergea în partea înspre care era cu faţa.
